summary: First-finish smoke test of ImpactOS. Backend auth (login/register/me), stats, all CRUD list endpoints, event create+delete, public org endpoint, and 401-on-unauth all pass. Frontend login redirects to /app with prefilled admin creds, dashboard renders animated stat cards, all sidebar nav routes reachable, every module dialog opens (events/volunteers/projects/partners/donations), Impact and Reports pages render, PDF generate button executes without JS error, logout returns to /login and /app redirects unauthenticated users to /login. Public org page renders hero + stats + donate/volunteer CTAs without auth.
passed: GET /api/public/org/hope-in-hand returns org + events + stats (200, no auth)
Frontend /login submits with prefilled admin credentials and redirects to /app
Dashboard shows stat-card-meals-made, stat-card-monthly-goal, stat-card-volunteer-hours, stat-card-volunteers-count
Sidebar navigation works: dashboard, events, volunteers, projects, partners, donations, impact, reports, settings, public-profile
new-event-btn opens event-dialog; new-volunteer-btn, new-project-btn, new-partner-btn, record-donation-btn open their dialogs
Reports generate-pdf-report-btn triggers jsPDF without JS error
logout-btn returns to /login; revisiting /app redirects to /login
Public /org/hope-in-hand renders hero, stat grid, donate & volunteer buttons
notes: One benign console 401 observed on unauthenticated /me probe from public page (expected). Event schema requires status in ['upcoming','completed','cancelled'] (documented for future test scripts).
